name: Jillian Farrow
headline: Helping advisors thrive | Director, Practice Management at Sun Life
about:
Advisors who let day-to-day operations take priority over managing their practice will become stagnant. I create just-add-water solutions to help advisors take back control of their professional growth and experience a renewed enthusiasm for what they do. 

I believe that everyone should love their job. If you're dreading going into work every day, or not getting excited about helping others, you're not really living life to its fullest potential. Think about how many years of your life you spend working... don't you want to enjoy those years? 

Here's why I love MY job... 

I have the privilege of partnering with investment and insurance advisors across Canada who are at all different stages of their careers. I work with them to help identify business building and marketing opportunities within their business through keynote presentations or one-on-one consultations. I get excited about meeting new people and am passionate about helping people reach their full potential. 

I am also committed to developing my high-performing team and a wider circle of employees through coaching and mentoring. Teaching is my vocation – it’s what I went to school for – and I thoroughly enjoy educating advisors. I’m proud of the strong relationships I have with advisors, our sales team, business partners, and leadership teams, as this brings me joy in my day. 

Recent achievements include being recognized as a 2019 Wealth Professional Young Gun, 2018 Inspirational Woman across Sun Life Canada. I have published several articles, and delivered keynote presentations to over 10,000 advisors over the course of my career.
